scope: P1-A64b complete classic Cheng Pu, Chunlao runtime, AI, WPF presentation and official portrait
selectedVersion: 一将成名官网经典程普（吴4体力，疠火、醇醪）

sources.use: 一将成名官方武将页冻结经典程普、疠火和醇醪文本：结束阶段无醇时可将至少一张杀置为醇；每当一名角色处于濒死状态时可弃置一张醇，令其视为使用酒。该页同时链接经典静态大图。
官方历史问答继续作为疠火转换来源、伤害事实和结算后失去体力边界的依据。

ruleText.lihuo: 你使用普通的〖杀〗可以改为火〖杀〗，若此〖杀〗造成过伤害，你失去1点体力；你使用火〖杀〗可以多选择一个目标。
ruleText.chunlao: 结束阶段，若没有〖醇〗，你可以将至少一张〖杀〗置于武将牌上，称为〖醇〗；每当一名角色处于濒死状态时，你可以将一张〖醇〗置入弃牌堆，令其视为使用〖酒〗。

implementation.storageInteraction: at the owner's end phase, only when the public Chun pile is empty, a private multi-step prompt selects at least one exact Slash from hand; finish moves every selected physical card to the owner-scoped public Chunlao zone
implementation.dyingInteraction: each living Chunlao owner may spend at most one public Chun in one dying occurrence; the physical card moves through Processing to DiscardPile while the dying victim is the source and target of one effective Alcohol use
implementation.aiPolicy: an AI owner stores one lowest-keep-value Slash as an explained public reserve instead of emptying its whole Slash hand; dying use is scored from public relation and victim state
implementation.deathCleanup: all remaining Chun cards move to DiscardPile when their owner dies

versionBoundary.replayPolicy: accepted commands reconstruct paused storage selection, exact public Chun cards, virtual Alcohol rescue, movement ledger and completed event history under rules v101
versionBoundary.legacyPolicy: package 1.91.0 retains Lihuo without publishing the incomplete Cheng Pu general; the package signature and content hash provide the boundary

portrait.attribution: Official classic Cheng Pu artwork reused only for the user's local experiment under explicit authorization

acceptance.targetedWpfCommand: isolated Release build, then dotnet CardGame.Wpf.Tests.dll <render-dir> --only-cheng-pu
acceptance.fullWpfCommand: isolated Release build, then dotnet CardGame.Wpf.Tests.dll <render-dir>
acceptance.visualReview: 212 through 215 at 1120x740 inspected: card, private selection, public Chun badge and dying response are readable without clipping or overlap
assertions: package 1.92.0 publishes complete Cheng Pu while package 1.91.0 and rules v113 retain their old boundaries
paused multi-card selection is private, exact and replayable
stored Chun cards are public and remain in one owner-scoped physical zone
one Chun becomes one effective Alcohol used by the dying victim and follows the movement ledger
AI stores one explained reserve instead of every Slash
WPF exposes trigger choices, public pile details, rescue response and battle cues

deferred: real Windows desktop mouse and keyboard acceptance
physical multiplayer host and remote-client acceptance
